Planetary Hours

From sunrise to sunset is cut into twelve "day hours", and sunset to sunrise into twelve "night hours". Each belongs to a planet in the old Chaldean order. Tap one to read it; the current hour is outlined.

Tropical zodiac, geocentric positions computed live in your browser. Rising sign and hours use the place above.

The Whole Deck

Rider–Waite–Smith images: restored scans of a 1909 printing (art by Pamela Colman Smith), public domain in the US. The Thoth deck's paintings are still under copyright, so the Thoth view shows an original emblem with the Thoth titles and attributions. Here the cards are used for study and contemplation rather than fortune-telling.
